title: Balance under Boolean duality
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and suppose its real-valued form has mean zero under the uniform distribution. The function obtained by negating the output of $f$ at the coordinatewise negation of its input also has mean zero under the uniform distribution.
